result.summary: The page is mostly well-formed, but one card image failed to load: the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card in the 'Popular right now' section shows a gray placeholder box with a broken-image icon instead of a photo, while its badge and favorite button still render. Other elements (header, search, chips, promo banner, carousels) look consistent.

issues.description: The main image of the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card in the 'Popular right now' section failed to load and displays a gray placeholder with a broken-image glyph, unlike the other cards which show real food imagery.
issues.suggestion: Fix the image source/URL for this card or provide a proper fallback image; ensure the error state shows a branded placeholder rather than a broken-image icon.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) button on the broken-image card sits on a plain gray placeholder, and the gray circular background looks inconsistent with the dark translucent circle used on the pizza card below.
issues.suggestion: Use a consistent favorite-button background treatment across cards regardless of image load state.
